title: FizzBuzz
description:
Print FizzBuzz from 1 to 15 with jumps.

```
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
...
FizzBuzz
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
fizz:   db      "Fizz", 0
buzz:   db      "Buzz", 0
both:   db      "FizzBuzz", 0

        section .text
_start:
        mov     ebx, 1
.loop:
        ; TODO
        inc     ebx
        cmp     ebx, 15
        jle     .loop

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `mov eax, ebx` / `xor edx, edx` / `mov ecx, 15` / `div ecx` / `test edx, edx` / `jz .both` (lesson 3.04).
Each branch ends with `jmp .next`, where `.next` prints the new line, so only one branch runs.
requirements: Use `div` to test divisibility by 3 and 5.
Check 15 first, then 3, then 5, as an `if / else if` chain of jumps.
stretch: Print `Fizz` and `Buzz` by checking 3 and 5 separately and remembering whether anything was printed.
